item.tib: 'jig byed gshin rje gshed dmar ma mo srid pa spyi 'dul gyi rgyud las snang srid zil gnon khyung gi 'khor lo
item.coloph: ces ma mo srid pa spyi 'dul las kyi thig le'i rgyud las zil gnon khyung gis (gi) 'khor lo 'di ni/ mched grogs snying gi thig ler gyur pa rnams kyi (kyis) bskul ngor/ me sbrul hor zla lnga pa'i dmar phyogs su/ kun grol grags pa bdag gis dge bshes bstan 'dzin dbang rgyal po yab sras kyi pho brang bsam 'grub seng rdzong du brtsams pa dge'o//
